Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9.43 Sydney Steel Precinct 43

Clause 9.43.1 - land_use_zoning (land_use_zoning): The land-use pattern of the area generally consists of a mixture of general industrial uses, some commercial (business) uses, and some light industrial uses in the south western section of the precinct.

Clause 9.43.1 - land_use_zoning (land_use_zoning): Properties south of Marrickville Road, with frontages onto Meeks Road are zoned for office and light industrial uses, creating a buffer between residential and industrial uses.

Clause 9.43.1 - height_limit (development_control): The average height in the precinct is one to three storeys.

Clause 9.43.1 - heritage (development_control): There are no Heritage Conservation Areas contained within the precinct.

Clause 9.43.1 - heritage (development_control): However, the precinct does contain a number of listed heritage items, one of State Significance., being the Sydenham Pit and Drainage Pumping Station.

Clause 9.43.1 - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): The entire precinct is affected by flooding.

Clause 9.43.2 - other (development_control): To protect the identified Heritage Items within the precinct.

Clause 9.43.2 - land_use_zoning (land_use_zoning): To protect the integrity and on-going retention of the existing industrial zoned land, particularly those identified as being of State significance.
